title: Devil's Canary
description: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a large yellow demonic bird with red eyes and horns perched on a stone pedestal, chained in gold. A blue-skinned horned devil stands behind a blonde woman in a blue corset dress, both bound by heavy chains. The dark background shows ornate metal gates, yellow and white roses, and numerous silver wind chimes and bells hanging from above with red and blue ribbons.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy painting shows a giant angry yellow demonic canary with horns and red eyes perched on a stone pedestal, wrapped in golden chains. Behind it stands a muscular blue devil with black horns grinning, his arm around a beautiful blonde woman wearing a tight blue and red corset dress. Both are chained. The background is a stormy night sky with ornate gothic metal archways covered in yellow and white roses, while dozens of silver wind chimes and bells hang from above with flowing red and blue ribbons.
